title: Insurance Coverage & Claims: Amount Carried by a Coordination Claim for an Other-Coverage Denial
content:
**Claims correction calculation rule — Insurance Coverage & Claims, coordination corrections (CO-22).** This rule fixes the amount a coordination claim carries when Halverson Clinical Laboratories answers an other-coverage denial on a claim held by a coverage.

**Objects.** The claim corrected is the claim carrying the most recent other-coverage denial on the coverage, the order is the order that claim bills, and the order's invoice is the patient invoice that bills that order. The denial's amount is the claim's other-coverage denial amount; the claim's filing date and the amount it billed at filing are those of its original submission.

**Amount carried.** The amount the coordination claim carries is the denied amount being resubmitted: the other-coverage denial's amount less the part of the order's later credits and invoice corrections that falls on it. The order's credits that come off and the invoice corrections that come off are first added together, and that total is multiplied by the coordination correction's share before it is taken off the denial's amount; the amount carried is never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, with no rounding before the final cent.

**Values.** The coordination correction's share is one. No order credit comes off. The billing-error corrections adjusted on the order's invoice come off once their total reaches the invoice minimum of 15.00 USD, and otherwise none of them does.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Denial's amount | Billing-error corrections on the invoice | Reaches 15.00? | Taken off | Amount carried |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 275.00 | 15.00 | Yes | 15.00 | **260.00** |
| 275.00 | 14.99 | No | 0.00 | **275.00** |
| 275.00 | 22.40 | Yes | 22.40 | **252.60** |
